title: Advanched White
description: Whitelist plugin with temporary access, twink management, closed mode, player stats, and customizable messages
body:
AdvancedWhite is a flexible Minecraft whitelist plugin for Spigot/Paper that supports permanent and temporary access, twink management, closed-server mode, player playtime stats, and configurable reminder messages. * Permanent and temporary whitelist entries * Twink support * Closed mode * Player statistics * Paginated list and stats display * LuckPerms support ## Usage ### Admin commands * `/white list` — view the whitelist * `/white add ` — add a player to the whitelist * `/white remove ` — remove a player from the whitelist * `/white addtemp ` — add a player to the temporary whitelist * `/white timetemp ` — change a player’s temporary whitelist duration * `/white twink add ` — add a twink to a player * `/white twink remove ` — remove a twink from a player * `/white reload` — reload the plugin configuration ### Closed mode * `/white closed close` — close the server for everyone except players in the closed allow list * `/white closed open` — reopen the server * `/white closed add ` — add a player to the closed allow list * `/white closed remove ` — remove a player from the closed allow list * `/white closed list` — view the closed allow list ### Player commands * `/white mytwink add ` — add a twink for yourself * `/white mytwink remove ` — remove one of your twinks * `/white stat` — view player statistics * `/white temp` — check remaining temporary whitelist time ## Permissions `white.list` - View the whitelist
`white.add` - Add a player to the whitelist
`white.remove` - Remove a player from the whitelist
`white.addtemp` - Add a player to the temporary whitelist
`white.timetemp` - Change temporary whitelist duration
`white.twink.add` - Add a twink to a player
`white.twink.remove` - Remove a twink from a player
`white.reload` - Reload the plugin
`white.closed.close` - Enable closed mode
`white.closed.open` - Disable closed mode
`white.closed.add` - Add a player to the closed allow list
`white.closed.remove` - Remove a player from the closed allow list
`white.closed.list` - View the closed allow list
`white.mytwink.add` - Add a twink for yourself
`white.mytwink.remove` - Remove a twink from yourself
`white.stat` - View statistics
`white.stat.all` - View statistics for everyone
`white.temp` - View remaining temporary whitelist time
